text_block_list.text: The day after the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Regarding the test results, there were no 
notable abnormalities this time either.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, given that it only happened 
yesterday, a considerable amount of 
fatigue has accumulated. Please continue 
to make sure she doesn't push herself too 
hard."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your hard work in the 
'Japan Cup.'

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: Bubble, about what comes next—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――... Oh. Sorry, did you need something?
choice_data_list:
Shall we go grab something sweet after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose you're right. Yeah, alright.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Somehow... now I feel like eating too!
choice_data_list:
Actually, there's somewhere I'd like to 
go.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you know a place you'd recommend? 
Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-san. Is there really a 
shop in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: âAh, Bubble-chan is here! Ohooooy!

text_block_list.text: ...! Everyone—

"...There before our eyes, Sol Lapis and 
the others had spread out a whole bunch of 
snacks on a picnic mat."

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bubble. Glad it cleared up today. 
It's a perfect day for a tea party.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Come, please sit right here. Trainer-san, 
you're welcome to join as well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: —Wait!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...We made a promise, remember?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
We agreed that if I win both the Kikuka 
Sho and the Tenno Sho (Autumn), we'd throw 
a victory party.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: I feel like... now is that time.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I don't have the face to see everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
After running a race like that... at the 
Japan Cup, I...

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
......Indeed, just like the you up until 
now—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't the kind of running that pulled 
further and further ahead while I was 
still hesitating... It wasn't like that at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
“Yet... Just as during the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), I could feel your feelings.”

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"They are fighting desperately against 
themselves, trying to carve out a future 
for our sake—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Those feelings of yours reached me loud 
and clear in that race."

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Bubble. Trainer told all of us 
about the burden you're carrying right 
now."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list:
Sorry. I just felt like you needed to 
know.

I'm sorry. I just thought you ought to 
know.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Why would you keep secrets from me, 
Bubble-chan...! Why didn't you tell me? 
That you weren't actually in top shape...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...There's no way I could talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"After building up everyone's expectations 
this much, to say something like 'I can't 
run all out'—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm the one who wanted 
this...! So how could I ever talk 
about...! How pathetic I am...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Bubble-chan...—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ................Thank you, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I told you earlier, didn't I? That I could 
feel your passion.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"To be completely honest... I was actually 
more inspired by your run in the Japan 
Cup."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...You embraced my grief when I could no 
longer run. You tried to help us look 
forward."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Even knowing she might not be able to run 
at her best, she didn't run away. For the 
sake of us Four Heavenly Kings, she 
bravely fought against the world's 
strongest rivals."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"You criticized your own race, calling it 
'nothing special,' but—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...I felt immensely proud.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"It made me feel, from the bottom of my 
heart... that even if it hurts, I want to 
fight to carve out my own path, just like 
you."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—You know... I've decided to officially 
retire from racing.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Instead... I'm thinking of following the 
path of training the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I was able to make this decision... 
because I saw your race.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Waltz—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna conquer both dirt and turf to 
reach the very top!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
I will set my sights on the Senior-class 
Classic road. ...Looks like I might be 
running with you the most, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Lapis... Cure...—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...I think we relied too much on you, our 
'point rider.'"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Still, from now on, it'll be different. 
We're going to carve out our own path 
ourselves! Just like Bubble-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
And when times are tough, we'll support 
each other. Even more strongly than ever 
before.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Next, it's our turn to make you look 
forward.
choice_data_list: ...Everyone wants to lend you a hand.
...Everyone wants to lend you a hand.

text_block_list.text:
...Everyone in the Big Four already 
offered yesterday to help Bubble Gum 
Fellow get his original running style 
back.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Everyone...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since the Japan Cup... it feels as 
though the whirlwind we stirred up... has 
started to fade away...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though my dream... had burst 
and vanished—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to do... anymore...
choice_data_list: —Even if it pops, you'll be fine.
—Even if it pops, it'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

Yes, even if dreams burst and vanish. That 
is by no means the end of everything—

—Back then, Bubble Gum Fellow showed it to 
me when I was on the verge of losing my 
dream.

“You can expand your dreams anytime,” she 
said.

If so. If one can let their dreams expand 
at any time—
choice_data_list:
Dreams can grow as big as you want, as 
many times as you want

Dreams can grow as big as you want, as 
many times as you want, you know

text_block_list.text:
If it's her, who has opened the path for 
everyone here and helped their dreams 
blossomâ

If it's Bubble Gum Fellow, the 'vanguard' 
of the Big Four, he can definitely do it. 
Because—
choice_data_list:
Because you have the power to keep giving 
people dreams...!

Because you have the power to keep giving 
everyone dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Dreams can grow bigger again and again.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...That's right... Exactly...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Waltz. Cure. Lapis—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, truly. ...I feel like my eyes 
have been opened.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Right here, right now, in front of 
everyone, I declare it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it back, without fail. My 
running. And also—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I will carve open the future once 
more...! I'll make it swell bigger than 
ever before...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Our dream...! The existence of us, the 
Heavenly Kings...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why— I want to ask for everyone's 
help once again...!

Bubble Gum Fellow's fist, the Heavenly 
Kings' fists, and my own fist came 
together in a bump.
—At that moment, I felt it for sure.

That my dream had begun to expand once 
more—
—That night.

Bubble Gum Fellow and I were discussing 
her upcoming race rotation.

"The Takarazuka Kinen is a 2,200m turf 
middle-distance GⅠ race held at Hanshin 
Racecourse, and—"

Along with the Osaka Hai and Tenno Sho 
(Spring), it's part of the Spring Senior 
Triple Crown—and the Grand Prix that marks 
its grand finale.

There is no race more fitting than this to 
once again make an impression of Bubble 
Gum Fellow as the strongest at medium 
distance...!

text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen will be held next
